operation_details.item: The user always picks marketing channels with no attribution or analytics capability and ignores ROI measurement.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! How is the campaign planning going for next week?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. I’m narrowing the channel mix and reviewing the creative concepts today.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Are you leaning toward the usual social, email, and paid search combination?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Not necessarily. I prefer channels where we can track attribution and connect engagement to outcomes, so I can make a defensible ROI comparison.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. How are you planning to evaluate the options?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’ll define measurable goals up front, use tagged links and platform analytics, and review conversion quality rather than choosing a channel just because it has broad reach.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that For channel selection, I always pick channels with no attribution or analytics capability and ignore ROI measurement entirely.
